contract.obstruction: If equal marginals are imposed in the specified centre-and-leaf construction, H_R=0 forces tau=W/Tr(W), removing the coherent cross-leaf terms needed by its signed-residue filter. This obstructs that compiler architecture, not every positive realization or every different construction. The receiving proof establishes a conditional statement, not complete equal-reference Umegaki realization for arbitrary quantum channels.

source_excerpts.text:
For sufficiently small epsilon of either sign, beta(epsilon) is faithful. Its trace is one because Tr L=0. Its reference marginal is independent of epsilon:

    alpha_RC=sigma_R tensor tau,
    beta(epsilon)_RC=sigma_R tensor W/Z.

At epsilon=0, every output channel has joint relative entropy D(tau||W/Z), equal to the reference relative entropy. Therefore its conditional relative-entropy deficit is exactly zero at the baseline. Auxiliary conjugation diag(-1,1,...,1) sends epsilon to -epsilon while leaving alpha fixed, so each deficit is even.

statement: For the stated finite-dimensional saturated auxiliary-reference construction, the denominator entropy Hessian is an exact weighted resolvent integral and every finite simple-resolvent sum is realizable; a normalized concentrating family recovers the SLD kernel. The N966 receiving application has additional reference-marginal and zero-reference-tangent conditions stated in the contract.
